interventions.dose: 50 ug/mL in PBS, 5 uL/mouse, intrathecal, 3 consecutive days

combinations.magnitude: IGF1 antibody did not alleviate mechanical hypersensitivity in 4E-BP1-cKO mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Administration of the IGF1-neutralizing antibody (50) did not alleviate mechanical hypersensitivity in 4E-BP1–cKO mice (Supplemental Figure 4F), suggesting that the increased pain hypersensitivity in these mice was not mediated through CD11c+ microglia/IGF1 signaling.
